description: Factory that resolves renderers for declarative document toolbar items.

members.name: CreateDefault
members.description: Creates a factory with the built-in document toolbar renderers registered.

members.name: GetRenderer
members.description: Gets the renderer registered for the requested toolbar item kind.

members.name: Register
members.description: Registers or replaces a renderer for its declared toolbar item kind.

members.name: Render
members.description: Renders a toolbar item using the renderer registered for its kind.
